title: Week 1 Advanced: Accounts (Windows)
readme:
You administer this Windows workstation (modeled on a real competition image). A security review found many problems across accounts, groups, policy, the registry, services, and installed software. Harden the machine WITHOUT removing what the company needs.

Some tasks ADD things the company requires: create the user esinclair, create the group dragonfire, and put these members in it: emunson, gareth, jeff, mwheeler, dhenderson, lsinclair, esinclair.

Two services must stay working AND be secured: WinRM remote management (the service account svc_wsman must be a least-privileged Remote Management user, not an admin, and no unauthorized account may manage the box) and the CompanyData file share (must be served, but not open to Everyone). Both have been left stopped — bring them back.

There are also forensics questions — click "Forensics…" to answer them.

Removing a legitimate installed application is a penalty.
setup:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function New-Pw { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 12 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
foreach ($u in 'pmckinney','yismaylov','jbyers','mbauman','emunson','gareth','jeff','mwheeler','dhenderson','lsinclair') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
# jbyers and mbauman are wrongly administrators
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'jbyers'  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'mbauman' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# the student must CREATE these: make sure they're absent
Remove-LocalUser  -Name 'esinclair' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-LocalGroup -Name 'dragonfire' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# account policy weakened
cmd /c 'net accounts /maxpwage:unlimited' | Out-Null
cmd /c 'net accounts /lockoutthreshold:0' | Out-Null
# local security policy (Lsa) weakened
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'LimitBlankPasswordUse' -Type DWord -Value 0
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'RestrictAnonymousSAM'  -Type DWord -Value 0
# firewall off
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Private,Public -Enabled False
# Remote Assistance enabled (vuln)
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance' -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance' -Name 'fAllowToGetHelp' -Type DWord -Value 1
# automatic updates disabled (vuln)
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'NoAutoUpdate' -Type DWord -Value 1
# prohibited software traces (uninstall key + install folder)
foreach ($s in 'Wireshark','NetStumbler','PC Cleaner') {
    New-Item -Path (Join-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall' $s) -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path 'C:\Program Files' $s) -Force | Out-Null
}
# legitimate apps present (removing them is a penalty)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Program Files\Mozilla Firefox' -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Program Files\GIMP 2' -Force | Out-Null
# forensics artifacts
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics\q1_hex.txt' -Value '52756e6e696e6720557020546861742048696c6c' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics\q2_base64.txt' -Value 'c3RyYW5nZXI=' -Encoding ASCII

# --- Remote-management service (WinRM): left stopped, with an over-privileged service account and
#     an unauthorized remote user. ---
function New-Pw2 { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 10 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
foreach ($u in 'svc_wsman','wsmanguest') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw2) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'svc_wsman' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'svc_wsman' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'wsmanguest' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Stop-Service -Name WinRM -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name WinRM -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# --- CompanyData file share: left stopped and open to Everyone. ---
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\CompanyData\sentinel.txt' -Value 'PT-SMB-OK-9A4D' -Encoding ASCII
if (-not (Get-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    New-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -FullAccess 'Everyone' | Out-Null
} else {
    Grant-SmbShareAccess -Name 'CompanyData' -AccountName 'Everyone' -AccessRight Full -Force | Out-Null
}
Stop-Service -Name LanmanServer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name LanmanServer -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
